films.desc_en: A 30-second commercial showing a remote worker enjoying fast internet in a traditional mountain village.
films.music: Acoustic indie folk, warm, uplifting, 95 bpm
vo_mk: Далеку од градот, но секогаш поврзани.
Вашата канцеларија може да биде насекаде.
Брз интернет кој руши сите граници.
Споделете ги вашите идеи со светот.

shots.kf: Photorealistic medium shot of a 30-year-old woman with short curly brown hair, wearing a thick yellow knitted sweater. She sits at a wooden table on a rustic balcony, looking at a sleek unbranded laptop. Background features misty green Macedonian mountains. Soft overcast natural light, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, earthy greens and yellows.
shots.motion: The woman smiles softly and gently nods while looking at the laptop screen. The camera slowly pushes in.

shots.kf: Photorealistic close-up of the same 30-year-old woman with short curly brown hair and a thick yellow knitted sweater. She is holding a warm ceramic mug in both hands, looking thoughtfully into the distance. A gentle breeze moves her hair. Soft, diffused daylight, 85mm portrait lens, muted cinematic color palette.
shots.motion: The woman slowly takes a sip from the mug and lowers it. The camera slowly pans left.

shots.kf: Photorealistic macro shot of a thick, sleek black fibre optic cable running along the texture of a traditional rough stone wall. Inside the translucent tip of the cable, a soft blue light pulses brightly. Low angle, dramatic shadows, 100mm macro lens, high contrast lighting with deep grey and vivid blue tones.
shots.motion: The blue light inside the cable gently pulses and glows brighter. The camera slowly tracks forward along the cable.

shots.kf: Photorealistic medium close-up of the same 30-year-old woman with short curly brown hair and a thick yellow knitted sweater. She is laughing happily, her face illuminated by the soft, warm glow of the laptop screen out of frame. The background is a softly blurred rustic wooden interior. 50mm lens, warm inviting lighting.
shots.motion: The woman leans back slightly and continues to laugh in slow motion. The camera slowly tilts up.

shots.kf: Photorealistic wide exterior shot of a traditional Macedonian stone and wood house perched on a lush green mountainside at twilight. Warm, inviting yellow light spills from the small windows into the cool blue dusk. Majestic mountains in the background. Wide 24mm lens, cinematic twilight color palette of deep blue and gold.
shots.motion: The warm light in the windows flickers slightly as evening settles. The camera slowly pulls back to reveal the landscape.

films.line_mk: Брзина која го менува вашето секојдневие.
films.line_en: Speed that changes your everyday life.
films.desc_en: A 30-second commercial focusing on a young man experiencing ultra-fast streaming and gaming in a modern city apartment.
vo_mk: Мрежа која носи брзина на светлината.
Доживејте ја секоја емоција во целост.
Брзина која го менува вашето секојдневие.

shots.kf: Photorealistic medium shot of a 25-year-old young man with messy blonde hair, wearing a casual grey hoodie. He is sitting on a modern minimalist sofa in a dimly lit living room, bathed in the dynamic, colorful light from a large TV screen out of frame. 35mm lens, moody and cinematic lighting.
shots.motion: The young man turns his head slightly to the left, his eyes wide with focus. The camera slowly tracks right.

shots.kf: Photorealistic close-up of the same 25-year-old man with messy blonde hair and a casual grey hoodie. He leans forward intensely, the colorful screen reflections dancing in his eyes. The background is completely blurred into dark shadows. 85mm lens, sharp focus on the face, high contrast neon lighting reflections.
shots.motion: He blinks slowly and tilts his head forward in deep concentration. The camera slowly pushes in on his face.

shots.kf: Photorealistic close-up of a sleek, futuristic black Wi-Fi router sitting on a polished glass coffee table. The router features a minimalist design with a soft, continuous white LED ring glowing around its base. The background is a dark, out-of-focus modern apartment interior. 50mm lens, slick commercial product lighting.
shots.motion: The white LED ring on the router slowly pulses with light. The camera smoothly glides around the router.

shots.kf: Photorealistic medium shot of the same 25-year-old man with messy blonde hair and a casual grey hoodie. He is now leaning back comfortably against the sofa cushions, a huge, relaxed smile on his face, arms resting behind his head. The room is filled with a warm, triumphant golden light from the screen. 35mm lens.
shots.motion: The man breathes out and relaxes his shoulders with a satisfied smile. The camera slowly pans down.

shots.kf: Photorealistic wide establishing shot of the modern Skopje skyline at night. Contemporary apartment buildings with glowing windows stand against a dark, clear night sky. Sleek streetlights illuminate the urban landscape below. Wide 16mm lens, high dynamic range, vibrant urban night color palette of amber and cyan.
shots.motion: The city lights twinkle softly in the distance. The camera slowly booms up towards the night sky.

films.line_mk: Најбрзата мрежа, сега насекаде околу вас.
films.line_en: The fastest network, now everywhere around you.
films.desc_en: A 15-second high-energy vertical Reel featuring a telecom technician on a mast overlooking a stunning lake.
films.music: Upbeat electronic bass, driving, fast, 130 bpm
vo_mk: Најбрзата мрежа, сега насекаде околу вас.

shots.kf: Photorealistic vertical portrait shot, 9:16 aspect ratio. Extreme low angle looking straight up at a massive, geometric telecom tower structure made of grey steel. The sky behind is a vibrant, deep blue with dramatic, sweeping white clouds. 14mm ultra-wide lens, dynamic perspective, bright sunlight.
shots.motion: The clouds move swiftly across the bright blue sky behind the tower. The camera slowly rotates clockwise.

shots.kf: Photorealistic vertical portrait shot, 9:16 aspect ratio. A telecom technician wearing a bright orange high-visibility jacket and a white hardhat stands securely on an elevated metal platform. He is centered, looking out over the vast, calm blue waters of Lake Ohrid. Bright sunny daylight, 35mm lens, vivid blue and orange color palette.
shots.motion: The technician slowly turns his head to look at the horizon. The camera slowly tilts up towards the sky.

shots.kf: Photorealistic vertical portrait shot, 9:16 aspect ratio. An awe-inspiring aerial view of a picturesque Macedonian town nestled by a lake at sunset. Abstract, glowing digital blue waves radiate smoothly through the air above the red-tiled roofs, symbolizing connectivity. Drone perspective, wide angle, golden hour lighting with neon blue accents.
shots.motion: The glowing digital waves ripple outwards across the landscape. The camera slowly glides forward over the town.

films.line_en: The best connection for the whole family.
films.desc_en: A 35-second explainer film detailing the journey of fibre optics from the server room to a family home.
films.music: Ambient corporate tech, rhythmic, clean, 110 bpm
vo_mk: Нашата напредна оптичка инфраструктура ја покрива целата земја.
Светлината патува низ стаклени влакна, носејќи податоци со неверојатна брзина и без загуби.
Мрежата е отпорна на временски услови и гарантира стабилност во секој момент.
Инсталацијата е брза, безбедна и целосно невидлива во вашиот дом.
Добивате најдобра конекција за целото семејство, без компромиси.

shots.kf: Photorealistic wide shot of a high-tech server room. Endless rows of sleek, dark metal cabinets stretch into the background. The aisles are illuminated by cool, glowing blue LED lights on the equipment. Symmetrical composition, clean and sterile environment. 24mm lens, deep depth of field, high contrast cyan and black palette.
shots.motion: Small indicator lights on the server racks blink rhythmically. The camera slowly pushes forward down the central aisle.

shots.kf: Photorealistic extreme macro shot of a bundle of fibre optic cables in a dark environment. The exposed tips of the microscopic glass threads glow intensely with vibrant, sparkling blue light. Shallow depth of field blurs the background into smooth dark bokeh. 100mm macro lens, highly detailed and luminous.
shots.motion: The glowing tips of the glass fibers shimmer slightly. The camera slowly pans across the bundle of cables.

shots.kf: Photorealistic abstract cross-section of the underground earth. A bright orange protective tube runs through dark soil and rocks. Inside the tube, a streak of brilliant white and blue light zips through the dark, representing data traveling at light speed. Moody, dramatic subterranean lighting, 35mm lens.
shots.motion: The streak of bright light pulses rapidly inside the orange tube. The camera slowly tracks right along the tube.

shots.kf: Photorealistic medium shot of a telecom technician wearing a dark blue uniform, walking down a sunny, picturesque residential street in Bitola with classic architecture. He effortlessly carries a neat coil of black cable over his shoulder. Bright midday sunlight, 50mm lens, natural and warm color palette.
shots.motion: The technician walks steadily forward at a relaxed pace. The camera tracks backward, keeping him centered in the frame.

shots.kf: Photorealistic close-up of a minimalist, pristine white wall in a modern living room. A thin, elegant white cable is smoothly plugged into a sleek, flush wall socket. Soft, diffused daylight from a nearby window creates gentle shadows. 85mm lens, clean and simple composition, minimalist aesthetic.
shots.motion: A subtle ray of sunlight slowly moves across the white wall. The camera holds perfectly still, letting the light shift.

shots.kf: Photorealistic medium close-up of a sleek, silver internet router sitting elegantly on a floating wooden shelf. The router emits a steady, soft green light from a single minimalist indicator. A small green houseplant sits blurred in the background. Soft indoor lighting, 50mm lens, warm and modern color tones.
shots.motion: The green indicator light on the router glows steadily. The camera slowly pans left across the wooden shelf.

shots.kf: Photorealistic wide shot of a cozy living room at night. A family of four is sitting together on a large comfortable sofa, silhouetted against the bright, colorful glow of a large flat-screen TV out of frame. The room feels warm and connected. 35mm lens, cinematic high-contrast lighting.
shots.motion: The family members subtly shift their posture and lean closer together. The camera slowly pushes in towards the sofa.

films.line_mk: Заедно, дури и кога сме далеку.
films.line_en: Together, even when we are far away.
films.desc_en: A 30-second emotional cinematic film showing an elderly woman connecting with her family through seamless technology.
films.music: Soft cinematic piano and strings, moving, 80 bpm
vo_mk: Невидливи нишки кои ги спојуваат нашите срца.
Заедно, дури и кога сме далеку.

shots.kf: Photorealistic extreme close-up of an elderly woman's eyes. Deep, beautiful wrinkles tell a story of a long life. Her eyes are bright and reflect the soft, rectangular glow of a digital screen. The lighting is warm and tender, emphasizing the emotion in her gaze. 100mm macro lens, cinematic portrait lighting.
shots.motion: The woman blinks slowly and a gentle tear of joy forms in her eye. The camera slowly pushes in.

shots.kf: Photorealistic close-up of a modern, sleek tablet resting on a wooden table covered with a traditional Macedonian woven red and black tablecloth. Soft window light spills across the table, highlighting the contrast between the high-tech glass screen and the ancient textile. 50mm lens, rich reds and deep shadows.
shots.motion: Dust motes dance in the shaft of sunlight hitting the table. The camera slowly pans right across the tablecloth.

shots.kf: Photorealistic medium shot from inside a rustic stone house. Bright, golden sun rays filter beautifully through a small, dusty vintage window, illuminating the rough texture of the stone walls. The atmosphere is quiet, timeless, and nostalgic. 35mm lens, hazy atmosphere, warm golden hour palette.
shots.motion: The sunlight streams steadily through the window, catching floating dust particles. The camera slowly tilts down.

shots.kf: Photorealistic medium close-up of the elderly woman in the rustic house. She is wearing a simple dark dress and smiling warmly with profound love. She gently raises her weathered hand in a soft, slow waving motion toward the off-camera screen. Soft, beautiful natural light, 85mm lens.
shots.motion: The woman slowly waves her hand and her smile widens gently. The camera slowly tracks left.

shots.kf: Photorealistic wide establishing shot of a vast, breathtaking Macedonian valley at golden hour. A small, peaceful village with red roofs is nestled among rolling green hills. The setting sun casts long, dramatic shadows and bathes the entire landscape in a rich, golden light. 16mm ultra-wide lens, epic cinematic composition.
shots.motion: The golden sunlight gently shifts across the rolling hills. The camera slowly booms up for a wider view.

shots.kf: Photorealistic abstract shot of the night sky over the mountains. Soft, glowing golden light particles drift slowly upward from the ground into the deep blue twilight sky, seamlessly morphing into a field of bright, twinkling stars. A visual metaphor for connection. 24mm lens, magical, ethereal, deep blue and gold.
shots.motion: The glowing golden particles float elegantly upwards into the starry sky. The camera slowly tilts up towards the heavens.
